# Guides

Task-oriented guides to PlussMa. Each guide is a short series of complete programs with their real output; the API reference documents every function and type.

- [Time series](ts/guide.md): Transforms, diagnostics, ARIMA, volatility, vector, state-space and direct forecasting models.
- [Distributions](distr.md): Probability families, sampling and maximum-likelihood fitting.
- [Inference](infer.md): Tests of means, variances, ranks, distributions and tables.
- [Regression](regress.md): Least squares, generalised linear, quantile and polynomial regression.
- [Optimization](optim.md): Constrained and unconstrained optimization, linear and mixed-integer programming, derivative-free search and root finding.
- [Calculus](calculus.md): Functions as values, exact derivatives and integrals, vector calculus and operators that transform functions.
- [Numerical methods](numerics.md): Numerical integration, differential equations, interpolation and large linear systems.
- [Stochastic processes](stochastic.md): Stochastic integrals, Itô calculus, jump processes, SDE simulation and Malliavin calculus.
- [Finance](finance.md): Option pricing, Black-Scholes, implied volatility and stochastic-volatility models.
